notes.title: Update 0.4.6.69 Engineupdate und mehr
notes.content:
After well over half a year, the next major update is now live.
We patched ViperAttack to Unity version 2020.1 and had to upgrade or even develop many graphic shaders.
New:
- 1 more level added
- new enemies and weapons

Fixes / Revised:
- Improved collision detection for missiles
- Revised ice asteroids
- Many shaders and materials revised or newly developed as part of the changeover to Unity 2020.1
- Disabled collisions between asteroids and alien ships

notes.title: Update 0.4.4.205
notes.content:
changes:
- The settings for graphics and resolution can now also be made in-game under Settings
- The settings are now changed and saved immediately and not only when you exit the settings window
